title: Customer Success & Operations Associate
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success & Operations Associate em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Foundey

Foundey (formerly Uitify) is an embedded product design partner for early-stage SaaS and AI startups based in the United States. We help founders improve product clarity, user experience, and go-to-market execution through senior design thinking combined with fast, high-quality execution.

We partner closely with ambitious startup teams to transform complex ideas into intuitive products, compelling narratives, and scalable digital experiences. Our work sits at the intersection of product strategy, design excellence, and business growth.


THE ROLE

In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for our clients, ensuring they get maximum value

from our compliance solutions while supporting smooth internal operations. You will work at the

intersection of client relationship management, process optimization, and regulatory knowledge —

making this an ideal position for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.


THE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Customer Success
  • Serve as the dedicated point of contact for a portfolio of clients, building trusted long-term

relationships

  • Onboard new clients by guiding them through platform setup, training, and initial compliance

workflows

  • Conduct regular check-ins, business reviews, and health assessments to track client

satisfaction and product adoption

  • Proactively identify at-risk accounts and develop retention strategies in collaboration with

Sales and Product teams

  • Gather and synthesize client feedback to inform product roadmap and service improvements

Operations & Process Support

  • Support internal operational processes including workflow documentation, project tracking,

and reporting

  • Maintain accurate client data and interaction records in the CRM system (Notion)
  • Assist in the development and refinement of SOPs, playbooks, and knowledge base content
  • Monitor deliverables and deadlines on behalf of clients, flagging risks proactively.
  • Compliance Support
  • Develop a working understanding of the regulatory frameworks relevant to our clients (e.g.,

US and International entity compliance)

  • Help complete orders for compliance related services such as business formations and

Annual filings ect.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or operations
  • Exceptional written and verbal (English) communication skills with the ability to explain

complex concepts clearly

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and client accounts

simultaneously

  • Proficiency with Notion, Google and project management platforms is a plus
  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset with a high attention to detail
  • Experience supporting onboarding or implementation processes for software products


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will play a key role in shaping how an ambitious startup design partner communicates its value to the world.

Today, our biggest bottleneck is not delivery — it’s clarity. We are looking for someone who can help sharpen our story, accelerate our sales process, and build unmistakable positioning in a highly competitive market.

  • You’ll work directly with founders, influence business strategy, and have meaningful ownership over how Foundey grows, communicates, and wins clients.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Site Reliability Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Site Reliability Engineer


We are looking for a full-time, remote Site Reliability / DevOps Engineer with 3+ years of experience in high-availability cloud environments. This role is heavily focused on AWS infrastructure, CloudFormation, and CI/CD pipeline ownership, with an emphasis on improving reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.

This position is ideal for someone who operates with an engineering mindset, takes strong ownership, and is comfortable recommending and implementing improvements across infrastructure and pipelines. You will join a shared SRE/DevOps function, working closely with engineering teams to ensure scalable, secure, and cost-effective systems.

Our client is a leading energy technology company focused on digitizing fuel operations through a single, real-time platform. Their software connects people, equipment, and facilities to provide enterprise-wide visibility and data-driven insights that fuel asset optimization, improve operational efficiency, and help organizations manage risk, maintenance, and fuel logistics more effectively.


Responsibilities

  • Own and improve client's AWS-based infrastructure, with a strong focus on CloudFormation templates
  • Design, implement, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps + AWS integrations
  • Analyze and manage infrastructure costs , proactively identifying optimization opportunities
  • Work closely with engineering teams to:
  • Reduce their dependency on writing CloudFormation templates
  • Improve deployment processes and operational efficiency
  • Recommend and implement improvements across existing and new pipelines
  • Ensure proper monitoring, observability, and reliability standards before production releases
  • Support release processes (availability during release windows when needed)
  • Build and maintain reusable infrastructure and automation modules
  • Contribute to security best practices within cloud infrastructure
  • Collaborate in a safe Agile environment, participating in sprints and technical discussions


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 3+ years supporting a high-availability cloud environment in a DevOps, SRE, or Sysadmin role
  • Strong, hands-on experience with AWS/Azure
  • Experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines, particularly:
  • Azure DevOps
  • AWS-native tools or integrations
  • Systems and Infrastructure deployment and management practices


Preferred Experience

  • Extensive, detailed networking skills, including VPC, VPN, TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, or DNS
  • Experience provisioning, deploying, and supporting containers with Helm, Kubernetes (Kops), or Docker
  • Scripting and development experience using Python, Go, or bash with associated source control
  • Hands-on monitoring tool usage, including: AWS CloudWatch, Datadog, or similar tools
  • Experience with relational databases, such as MySQL and PostgreSQL, and document stores, such as MongoDB
  • Experience deploying applications in containers using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Microsoft Azure Cloud experience


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Account Representative
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Account Representative em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role


As an Account Representative, you will be responsible for expanding SHEMAR's presence in your assigned market by developing strategic customer relationships and turning technical advantages into commercial success. You will work closely with industry-leading utilities, EPCs, and industrial customers, helping them solve critical challenges while driving sustainable business growth.



Responsibilities


Market Development & Business Growth

• Develop and execute market expansion strategies based on the company's Key Account Map and regional business objectives.

• Identify new business opportunities and convert SHEMAR's technical advantages and product solutions into commercial orders.

• Continuously monitor market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities to drive market penetration.


Customer Relationship Management

• Build and maintain strong relationships with customers at multiple organizational levels, including technical teams, procurement departments, and senior executives. • Understand customers' strategic priorities and business challenges, positioning SHEMAR as a trusted long-term partner. • Support high-level business discussions and facilitate strategic decision-making processes.


Project & Opportunity Management

• Lead the full sales cycle for strategic projects, including UHV transmission, offshore wind power, and other critical power infrastructure applications. • Independently manage complex projects and contracts ranging from hundreds of thousands to millions of dollars. • Coordinate bidding, commercial negotiations, and project execution to ensure successful order closure and delivery.


Cross-functional Collaboration

• Act as the frontline representative of SHEMAR and work closely with internal technical experts, IEC standards specialists, engineering teams, and supply chain partners.

• Translate technical concepts into customer value propositions and effectively communicate solutions to various stakeholders.

• Ensure smooth project execution and maintain high levels of customer satisfaction.



Qualifications


Required

• Bachelor's degree or above.

• 3+ years of successful B2B sales experience, preferably in power utilities, energy, electrical equipment, or industrial sectors.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure.

• Fluent in English and Portuguese, both written and spoken.

• Willingness to travel frequently within the assigned region.


Preferred

• Experience selling to utilities, EPC companies, renewable energy developers, or large industrial customers.

• Familiarity with transmission & distribution (T&D), substations, insulators, or other power system equipment.

• Ability to speak additional local languages is a strong plus.

• Strong learning agility and the potential to grow into a strategic sales or business leadership role.



Who We Are Looking For


• Ambitious and entrepreneurial, with a strong desire to create long-term impact.

• Practical problem-solvers who can navigate challenges and deliver results.

• Resilient and adaptable in fast-changing market environments.

• Customer-oriented and eager to build trusted partnerships.

• Innovative thinkers who are willing to challenge conventions and explore new possibilities.



What We Offer


Competitive Compensation

• Competitive base salary positioned above industry benchmarks.

• Performance-based annual bonus.

• Attractive project commissions with uncapped earning potential.

• Additional incentives for exceptional business achievements.


Career Development

Clear career progression pathways: Sales Expert Track; Team Management Track; Cross-functional opportunities in Product Management and Marketing


Comprehensive Support

• Direct access to strategic target customer lists and key accounts.

• Strong technical backing from experienced engineers and industry experts.

• Opportunities to work on landmark projects in UHV, renewable energy, and global power infrastructure.

• International exposure and a platform for long-term professional growth.



Equal Opportunity Statement

We are committed to diversity and inclusivity.

title: Head of Compliance, Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Compliance, Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Head of Compliance & MLRO to oversee the company's compliance and regulatory responsibilities in Brazil. This role will support the business in maintaining a strong compliance culture, managing regulatory relationships, and ensuring alignment with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.


Working closely with local and regional stakeholders, the successful candidate will provide practical compliance guidance while supporting the company's growth and licensing initiatives in Brazil.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated MLRO and lead compliance representative for the Brazil business.
  • Oversee the company's compliance, AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial crime programs.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and provide guidance on relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain relationships with regulators and support regulatory enquiries, reviews, and examinations.
  • Support licensing, registration, and other regulatory initiatives as required.
  • Provide compliance advice to business and operational teams on new products, services, and business activities.
  • Help ensure policies, procedures, and controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory expectations.
  • Oversee key compliance processes, including customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Identify compliance risks and work with stakeholders to implement appropriate controls and solutions.
  • Prepare compliance updates and reporting for management.
  • Deliver compliance training and promote a strong culture of compliance across the organization.
  • Collaborate with regional and global teams on compliance-related matters.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets.
  • Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred.
  • Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous.
  • Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial.
  • Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment.
  • Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.


OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Digital Marketing Director
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Digital Marketing Director em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

SPOKEN ENGLISH IS A MUST!

*Please make sure to submit your resume in English; it will not be accepted otherwise. The interview process will also be conducted in English.


Digital Marketing Director

Location: Remote


About Us:

Smart Age Solutions is a leading digital marketing and technology agency specializing in the jewelry industry. We help some of the most recognized jewelry retailers and luxury brands grow through cutting-edge digital strategies, including SEO, Paid Media, Social Media, Email Marketing, Web Development, Conversion Optimization, AI-driven marketing solutions, and eCommerce.


With team members across the United States and Latin America, we combine deep industry expertise with innovation, data, and technology to deliver measurable growth for our clients.


As we continue to scale, we are seeking an experienced Marketing Director to lead our marketing organization, oversee department leadership, and help shape the future of our agency.



Role Overview

The Digital Marketing Director will serve as a senior leader within the company, responsible for overseeing the performance, strategy, and development of multiple marketing departments.

This role is not responsible for executing campaigns directly. Instead, the Marketing Director will lead and develop department managers across SEO, Paid Media, Social Media, Design, Copywriting, Content, and Marketing Operations while ensuring alignment, accountability, operational efficiency, and client success.


The ideal candidate is a proven marketing leader with agency experience, strong business acumen, exceptional people management skills, and a deep understanding of modern digital marketing strategies, analytics, automation, AI, and performance marketing.

This individual will play a critical role in scaling Smart Age Solutions while maintaining the quality, innovation, and results that define our brand.



Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute the company's overall marketing vision and departmental strategy.
  • Align marketing initiatives with company growth objectives, revenue goals, retention targets, and client success metrics.
  • Establish department-wide KPIs, accountability systems, and performance standards.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and profitability.


Department Leadership

  • Manage and mentor department managers across:
  • SEO
  • Paid Media (Google Ads, Meta Ads, Programmatic)
  • Social Media
  • Design & Creative
  • Copywriting & Content
  • Marketing Operations
  • Create clear growth paths, coaching programs, and professional development plans for leaders and team members.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.


Performance & Analytics

  • Establish and monitor KPIs across all service lines.
  • Analyze performance trends and identify opportunities for optimization.
  • Drive data-informed decision-making throughout the organization.
  • Ensure departments are delivering measurable results for clients.
  • Oversee reporting frameworks, dashboards, forecasting, and performance reviews.


Client Strategy & Growth

  • Partner with Account Management and Executive Leadership to support high-level client strategy.
  • Participate in key client meetings and executive reviews when strategic leadership is required.
  • Help identify opportunities for account growth, retention, and improved client outcomes.
  • Ensure marketing strategies align with client business goals and industry best practices.


Innovation & Technology

  • Champion the adoption of AI, automation, and emerging marketing technologies.
  • Evaluate new platforms, tools, and technologies that improve efficiency and results.
  • Drive innovation initiatives across departments.
  • Help position our company as a leader in digital marketing within the jewelry industry.


Operational Excellence

  • Improve workflows, processes, SOPs, and cross-department collaboration.
  • Ensure departments are properly staffed, resourced, and structured for growth.
  • Work closely with executive leadership to forecast hiring needs and organizational development.
  • Assist in building scalable systems that support the company's long-term growth strategy.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.


EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.


Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.


Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
  • Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
  • Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
  • Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
  • Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
  • Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
  • Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
  • Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;


Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
  • +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
  • +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
  • Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
  • Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
  • Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making;
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
  • Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
  • AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
  • Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;
  • Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

  • Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus;
  • Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage;
  • Fluent in English;

  • Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making;

  • AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
  • Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

  • Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus;
  • Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage;
  • Fluent in English;

title: Remote Business Analyst (German)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

description:

The Challenge

Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI.

We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale.


Why This Role Might Be for You

Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn.

You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate.

Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build.


Key Responsibilities

Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities.

Today: Execution and Precision

  • Refine and optimize models already in production using AWS Bedrock, continuously improving accuracy and performance.
  • Validate data, rules, and outputs manually when needed. In healthcare, data quality is non-negotiable.
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement fast feedback loops so the system improves continuously.

Tomorrow: Scale and Architecture

  • Help evolve our infrastructure into a robust ecosystem using RAG pipelines and vector databases.
  • Move from a centralized AI solution toward a network of specialized models by context and insurance payer.
  • Contribute to fine-tuning proprietary models using our historical data to create a unique competitive advantage.


What We’re Looking For

  • Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required.
  • Bias for action: You move fast, take initiative, and understand that speed matters in an early-stage company.
  • Hands-on coding ability: Solid practical experience with Python or Go, plus experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock.
  • Builder mindset: You enjoy creating robust systems from scratch and care deeply about precision, reliability, and business impact.


What We Offer

  • Early-stage impact: Be one of the early team members in a fast-growing company and help shape both the architecture and the culture.
  • High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI.
  • Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful.
  • Remote flexibility: 100% remote work, open to candidates based in Brazil.
  • Long-term upside: Potential equity participation for people who help build the business with us.
  • Legacy: Your work will leave a real mark on the product, the codebase, and the company’s story.

title: Transmission Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Transmission Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Transmission Line Engineer - LATAM


Our client is seeking a Transmission Line Engineer to join their growing engineering team. This role will be responsible for supporting the analysis, design, and execution of overhead transmission line projects for utility and energy clients.


The ideal candidate will have experience in transmission line design, power systems, and engineering project delivery, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.


This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and contributing to the successful delivery of critical power infrastructure projects.


Key Responsibilities

  • Perform and coordinate transmission line engineering activities for new and existing overhead transmission projects.
  • Complete engineering analysis, calculations, and design work associated with transmission line systems.
  • Provide technical support to internal stakeholders, customers, and project teams.
  • Review project requirements and specifications and recommend design improvements when necessary.
  • Solve complex engineering challenges related to transmission line design and construction.
  • Prepare technical reports, analyses, calculations, and presentations.
  • Perform and oversee transmission line calculations, including:
  • Sag-tension analysis
  • Wire blowout calculations
  • Swing angle analysis
  • Damper recommendations
  • Conductor and wire selection
  • Support multiple projects simultaneously while meeting project schedules and deadlines.
  • Collaborate with engineering, sales, and project management teams to ensure successful project execution.
  • Travel occasionally to customer sites to support project meetings, technical presentations, and project development activities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, preferably with an emphasis in Power Systems.
  • Experience working on utility, transmission, or power infrastructure projects.
  • Familiarity with transmission line design software such as:
  • PLS-CADD
  • SAG10
  • ETAP
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team environment.


What We're Looking For

  • Self-motivated and results-driven professional.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to quality and accuracy.
  • Customer-focused mindset with excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Continuous learner with a passion for professional growth and development.
  • Team player who thrives in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.


Apply Today

If you are passionate about power systems, transmission engineering, and delivering innovative solutions for critical infrastructure projects, we would love to hear from you.

title: English Teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English Teacher em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Overview


Most English schools in Brazil sell the same thing: promises. Promises of fluency. Promises of confidence. Promises of transformation. And most of them fail to deliver. Not because their teachers aren't capable, but because their model was never built around results in the first place.


AM Consultoria de Inglês was built differently.


We work exclusively with adult learners, using a communicative approach that prioritises real speaking ability. We measure what actually matters: whether our students can use English to do something meaningful with their lives. Every class, every follow-up, every piece of feedback we give is designed with that outcome in mind.


We're growing. And we're looking for a teacher who wants to be part of something that takes results seriously.


If you want a place to clock in, teach, and clock out, this isn't it. If you want to build something that genuinely changes people's lives, read on.



Position Details


  • Role: English Language Coach
  • Location: 100% Remote
  • Employment Type: Contract
  • Start Date: Immediate


Candidates MUST be available Monday through Thursday, 7–9pm. Weekly team meeting: Mondays at 10am (30 minutes).



What You'll Do


  • Plan and deliver engaging, communicative classes that students actually remember
  • Support students via WhatsApp between sessions. We stay close to our learners
  • Proactively check in with students to understand their needs and keep them on track
  • Pursue your own professional development. We expect it and we support it



Technical Requirements


  • High-quality video and audio setup
  • Fast, stable internet connection



What We Require


  • CELTA, DELTA, or TKT certification (Cambridge)
  • C2 English proficiency
  • Strong command of Communicative Language Teaching methodology
  • Confident use of online teaching platforms and digital tools



What We're Looking For


Beyond qualifications, we're looking for someone who:


  • Brings genuine energy to every class, Not performance, real presence
  • Is ambitious and wants to grow, with potential to take on leadership responsibility
  • Receives feedback well and actively uses it to improve
  • Communicates proactively and takes ownership of their students' progress
  • Is humble enough to keep learning, no matter their level of experience
  • Has lived, worked, or studied in an English-speaking environment (a strong advantage)



Why AM Consultoria


  • Above-average compensation compared to the broader ESL market in Brazil
  • A methodology that actually works, and that you'll be proud to deliver
  • Adult learners who are motivated, goal-driven, and serious about progress
  • Real input into how we develop and improve our product
  • A small, high-performance team that holds each other to a high standard
  • Room to grow into more than a teacher



We'll be sharing more about our vision, mission, and approach via the link below. If what you've read here resonates — we'd like to hear from you.


Apply now.

title: Senior Procurement Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Procurement Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Position Overview

This is not a traditional purchasing role.

We are looking for a procurement leader capable of building strategic relationships with manufacturers, distributors, fabricators, and suppliers across the building envelope industry.

The ideal candidate understands construction procurement, supply chain management, sourcing strategies, and supplier negotiations within industries such as:

  • Architectural Glass & Glazing
  • Curtain Wall Systems
  • Metal Fabrication
  • ACM & Metal Panel Systems
  • Building Envelope Products
  • Insulation Systems
  • Waterproofing & Air Barrier Systems
  • Fasteners & Specialty Construction Products

This individual will play a direct role in improving project profitability, strengthening supplier partnerships, and creating scalable procurement processes to support Longarone's next phase of growth.



Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and execute Longarone's procurement strategy.
  • Negotiate national and international supplier agreements.
  • Establish long-term strategic partnerships with manufacturers and distributors.
  • Lead sourcing initiatives focused on cost reduction and supply chain optimization.
  • Collaborate with Estimators and Project Managers during budgeting and project planning.
  • Evaluate new suppliers, products, technologies, and market opportunities.
  • Monitor commodity pricing trends and market fluctuations.
  • Manage procurement forecasting and material planning.
  • Improve procurement systems, reporting, and purchasing controls.
  • Coordinate material purchasing, logistics, and delivery schedules.
  • Present monthly procurement performance reports to executive leadership.



Desired BackgroundRequired
  • 7+ years of procurement, purchasing, sourcing, or supply chain experience.
  • Experience within construction, glazing, architectural glass, façade systems, building envelope, metal fabrication, or related industries.
  • Strong contract negotiation and supplier management experience.
  • Proven track record of generating measurable cost savings.
  • Ability to analyze pricing structures and supplier performance.
  • Fluent English communication skills.


Highly Preferred
  • Existing relationships with manufacturers and distributors in the façade, glazing, curtain wall, or architectural metals sectors.
  • Experience purchasing materials for commercial construction projects.
  • Knowledge of Passive House, high-performance building systems, and modern façade technologies.
  • Experience with ERP and procurement management software.


Success Metrics
  • Procurement Savings
  • Cost Avoidance
  • Supplier Reliability
  • Lead Time Reduction
  • Margin Improvement
  • Forecast Accuracy
  • Supply Chain Stability


Compensation

Competitive Base Salary + Performance Bonus

The selected candidate will participate in a Procurement Savings Incentive Program tied directly to measurable value creation through:

  • Supplier negotiations
  • Strategic sourcing
  • Cost reductions
  • Supply chain improvements
  • Margin enhancement initiatives

Top performers will have significant earning potential tied to their impact on company profitability.



Why Join Longarone?
  • Fully Remote Position
  • Direct Access to Executive Leadership
  • High Growth Environment
  • Opportunity to Build a World-Class Procurement Department
  • Performance-Based Compensation
  • Work on Landmark Building Envelope Projects Throughout the Northeast U.S.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Analyst - ServiceNow - Contractor in USD
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Quality Assurance Analyst - ServiceNow - Contractor in USD em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

For an international organization, we are urgently looking for a Full Remote Senior Quality Assurance Analyst with strong understanding of the ServiceNow suite.


Candidates need to be willing to work US office hours. This positions is long-term.


Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Designing the full testing framework - including unit, integration, system, regression, UAT, and performance testing - tailored to the ServiceNow customization;
  • Collaborating closely with the project team to understand application requirements, create test cases, and ensure comprehensive test coverage;
  • Coordinating with business owners, developers, and end-user representatives to ensure test scenarios reflect real-world usage across different regions, roles, and support request types;
  • Reviewing manual test cases and user stories in Azure DevOps projects;
  • Creating and managing test cases, test data, and defects in Azure DevOps;
  • Participating in Sprint planning and retrospective sessions;
  • Monitoring defect trends, test coverage metrics, and quality KPIs throughout the project lifecycle to refine the approach and prevent recurring issues across successive release cycles;


Profile:

  • Bachelor or Master degree;
  • +5 years of experience in a QA role;
  • +4 years of hands-on experience with Open-source testing tools (Selenium,TestNG/Junit, Cucumber,Appium etc.);
  • +2 years of experience with the Azure DevOps platform is required;
  • Strong understanding of the ServiceNow suite
  • API testing using Postman, Rest assured experience is a must;
  • Experience in automating system integration (mock/stubs) and E2E Tests;
  • +2+ Experience in mobile automation using Appium and cloud platforms like Browser stack /Lambda test;
  • Experience with a JavaScript framework such as CypressIO or similar with experience of testing with Node.js, React, Angular or similar JavaScript framework;
  • Knowledge of SAP and experience with test automation of SAP FIORI and GUI using UFT/QTP is highly desired;
  • Strong knowledge on Rest API, and working experience in REST API methods and operations, data serialization using JSON libraries;
  • Experience in implementing CICD using Azure DevOps or Jenkin or GitLab or Git actions;
  • Experience with object-oriented programming languages like Java/JS/Python is must;
  • Experience within both automated and manual testing, understanding the need and methodology behind incorporating both types of testing;
  • Experience in SCM, CICD and build management tools such Maven, Sonar, Git, Azure pipelines/Jenkins, Docker;
  • Other test automation frameworks like Selenide/Playwright/Jest is desirable;
  • Fluent in English;

title: PRODUCT DESIGNER SÊNIOR | REMOTO
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para PRODUCT DESIGNER SÊNIOR | REMOTO em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

LOCALIZA&CO

Estar em constante evolução nos trouxe até aqui. Ao lado de talentos e habilidades múltiplas nos conectamos em busca da nossa motivação: construir o futuro da mobilidade sustentável. É por meio da valorização da individualidade de cada um que impulsionamos o nosso movimento para conquistar resultados extraordinários, desenvolver nossas operações e criar soluções para os nossos clientes.

Somos apaixonados por nossa história, por nossas ideias e pela capacidade de realizá-las. Sabemos que juntos, todos vamos mais longe.

É assim que conectamos a Localiza&Co com o futuro.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como Product Designer Sênior, você terá um papel estratégico na construção de soluções complexas, atuando de forma transversal entre múltiplos produtos, squads e áreas de negócio.


Esperamos uma atuação que vá além da execução, com forte orientação estratégica, capacidade de influência e visão sistêmica. Você deve ser capaz de conectar decisões de design aos objetivos de negócio, antecipar problemas e oportunidades com base em contexto e dados, e atuar de forma proativa na definição de direcionamentos para produtos e jornadas complexas.


Você será responsável por:

  • Mapear e evoluir jornadas complexas, conectando diferentes produtos, jornadas e stakeholders, garantindo consistência e visão integrada da experiência;
  • Construir e manter relações de confiança com áreas parceiras e stakeholders (produto, tecnologia, negócio, marketing, operações), construindo alinhamento e direcionamento claro mesmo em cenários ambíguos;
  • Antecipar riscos e problemas de experiência, atuando de forma proativa para mitigá-los antes de impactarem o usuário ou o negócio;
  • Apoiar decisões estratégicas de produto, utilizando dados, experimentação e visão de negócio;
  • Promover a cultura de Design e pensamento centrado no usuário, elevando o nível de maturidade da organização;
  • Conduzir e orientar pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas, traduzindo dados em insights acionáveis;
  • Desenvolver soluções, jornadas e interfaces, garantindo excelência em usabilidade, consistência e impacto;
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento do time, compartilhando conhecimento, repertório e boas práticas.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Domínio de pesquisa com usuários (quali e quanti) e validação de hipóteses;
  • Excelência em UI e UX, equilibrando estética, usabilidade e consistência;
  • Domínio de Figma e ferramentas de prototipação em IA;
  • Excelente comunicação e articulação, com capacidade de simplificar temas complexos e influenciar decisões;
  • Forte habilidade de relacionamento, construindo parcerias sólidas e colaborativas com diferentes stakeholders;
  • Visão holística e sistêmica, entendendo o impacto das decisões de design no ecossistema como um todo;
  • Experiência em projetos complexos, envolvendo múltiplas squads, produtos e áreas;
  • Capacidade de navegar em ambientes ambíguos, trazendo clareza, direcionamento e foco;
  • Proatividade e senso de urgência, antecipando problemas e agindo no tempo certo;
  • Experiência em mapeamento de jornadas complexas e identificação de oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Habilidade em facilitar dinâmicas colaborativas, como co-criação, workshops e alinhamentos estratégicos;
  • Capacidade de mediação e gestão de conflitos, equilibrando diferentes interesses com foco no melhor resultado;
  • Pensamento orientado a dados e resultados, conectando design a métricas de negócio.


BENEFÍCIOS DESSA POSIÇÃO

  • Participação nos Lucros
  • Carro Corporativo
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale Refeição
  • Convênio Médico
  • Convênio Odontológico
  • Gympass
  • Previdência Privada

  • Allya
  • Acesso ilimitado a diversos cursos da nossa Universidade Localiza
  • Programas internos de treinamento e desenvolvimento

A Jusfy está em busca de uma pessoa Analista Pleno de Parcerias Institucionais. Somos uma legaltech em crescimento acelerado - desenvolvemos tecnologia, IA e ferramentas de produtividade para advogados e departamentos jurídicos do Brasil.

title: Analista de Suporte N1 – Front Office (Capital Markets)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Suporte N1 – Front Office (Capital Markets) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Vaga: Analista de Suporte N1 – Front Office (Capital Markets)

Contexto

Buscamos profissional para atuar no suporte de primeiro nível (N1) às aplicações de Front Office de uma grande instituição financeira, com foco em Mercado de Capitais / Renda Fixa . O profissional será responsável por garantir a estabilidade operacional dos sistemas utilizados pelas mesas de operações, atuando como ponto de contato direto entre traders, Middle Office e times de tecnologia.

Responsabilidades

  • Prestar suporte N1 às aplicações de renda fixa do Front Office.
  • Manter interação constante com traders e Middle Office para tratamento de incidentes e dúvidas operacionais.
  • Executar conciliações diárias (daily reconciliation) das operações e posições.
  • Identificar, analisar e escalar chamados para o suporte de N2 quando necessário.
  • Acompanhar e dar follow-up nos tickets , garantindo a resolução dentro do SLA.
  • Apoiar atividades de validação de dados (data validation) .
  • Participar de testes básicos (funcionais e de homologação dos sistemas).

Requisitos

  • Vivência em ambiente de Front Office (mesa de operações) .
  • Conhecimento do ciclo de vida das operações (trade lifecycle) e da interação entre Front e Middle Office .

The SAP BW Lead will be responsible for leading end to end SAP BW initiatives, including architecture, design, development, migration, and operational support across SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA landscapes. Advanced English

• Own delivery across implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support engagements.

Data Acquisition & Integration (SLT Focus)

o InfoObjects, ADSOs (Field based & InfoObject based)


o Composite Providers, Open ODS Views


o Transformations, DTPs, Process Chains


Design and optimize Native HANA objects, including:


o Calculation Views, Table Functions, SQL Script procedures

o CDS Views (where applicable)

• Leverage push down logic to HANA to improve query and load performance.


• Collaborate with BW and HANA teams to decide optimal BW vs Native HANA modeling strategy.


Reporting & Analytics:


Oversee reporting solutions using:


o BEx Queries / Analysis for Office / SAP BO / SAC (where applicable)


• Ensure reporting performance, semantic consistency, and business KPI alignment across domains (FI, CO, SD, MM, Supply Chain).


Migration & Modernization:


Lead BW on HANA / BW/4HANA conversion and migration programs, including:


o Readiness checks and simplification item handling


o Remediation of custom code and data models


o Data volume management and performance validation


• Support S/4HANA transformation programs from an analytics perspective.

Production Support & Governance

• Act as escalation point for production issues, SLA adherence, root cause analysis, and resolution.

• Ensure strong governance around transports (ChaRM), releases, incident/change management, and documentation.


Team & Stakeholder Leadership:


• Mentor and guide SAP BW developers and HANA modelers.

• Work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, architects, and program managers.

• Contribute to effort estimation, planning, and delivery commitments.

Quem Somos

title: \"Consultor SAP PP / PPDS Sênior # 1007834\"
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para \"Consultor SAP PP / PPDS Sênior # 1007834\" em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Dexian é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a Dexian atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.


Detalhes do projeto

Atuará em ambientes de alta complexidade e que tenha habilidade para atuar como ponte entre as diretrizes de um template global e as necessidades específicas da operação local. O grande desafio será conduzir a mudança de uma cultura organizacional acostumada com um ECC altamente customizado para a padronização e eficiência do S/4HANA, garantindo a conformidade com a Localização Brasil e as atualizações da Reforma Tributária.

Implantação e projeto de 10 meses (mínimo).


Atividades que irá exercer

Atuar ativamente no Rollout do template global S/4HANA, garantindo a aderência dos processos de planejamento e execução da produção (PP/PPDS):

· Realizar o mapeamento de processos (AS-IS/TO-BE) e identificar Gaps entre a operação atual (ECC customizado) e o novo padrão global.

· Configurar e parametrizar os módulos SAP PP e PPDS, focando em otimização de capacidade e sequenciamento fino.

· Liderar discussões técnicas e funcionais com times globais em Inglês, defendendo as necessidades de localização sem ferir a integridade do template.

· Garantir que os requisitos de Localização Brasil e os impactos da Reforma Tributária estejam refletidos nos processos de manufatura e suprimentos.

· Apoiar a estratégia de migração de dados e testes integrados (SIT/UAT).

· Atuar como agente de mudança, auxiliando os usuários na transição para os novos processos standard do S/4HANA.


Requisitos

Domínio técnico e funcional em SAP PPDS (Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling) :

· Experiência comprovada em projetos de implementação ou rollout para S/4HANA.

· Conhecimento profundo em processos de manufatura (MTS, MTO, Process, Discrete).

· Experiência prévia com Localização Brasil (Impostos, NFe integrada à produção, etc.).

· Habilidade de negociação para lidar com stakeholders de diferentes países e culturas.

Conhecimento prévio ou estudos sobre os impactos da Reforma Tributária no ecossistema SAP .

· Certificação oficial SAP S/4HANA (PP ou PPDS).

· Experiência em projetos de grande escala em landscapes globais e integrados.

· Conhecimento em outros módulos integrados (MM, QM ou SD).

IMPRESCINDÍVEL Inglês Avançado para conversação.


Onde vc vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

IMPORTANTE - Ter disponibilidade para viagens esporádicas a Belo Horizonte-MG.


Regime de Contratação:

Flexível.

title: User Experience Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para User Experience Designer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Our culture isn’t something people join, it’s something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a fit, we say go for it. Let’s build something great together.



We're looking for a Visual (UX) Designer with exceptional visual design skills to support a large-scale Design System initiative for a leading enterprise software platform. This role is focused on visual exploration, design systems thinking, and crafting polished user interface experiences that can scale across complex products


You'll work closely with an established Design System team to help define and evolve the visual language of the platform. This is a highly collaborative role where you'll explore design directions, create high-fidelity concepts, evaluate design solutions, and help bridge brand expression with scalable system design.


Must Haves

  • 5+ years of experience in UX/UI, Product Design, or Visual Design roles with a strong emphasis on user interface design and visual craft.
  • Outstanding visual design portfolio demonstrating excellence in typography, color systems, spacing, hierarchy, layout, iconography, and interaction design.
  • Experience working within or contributing to design systems, with an understanding of how visual decisions scale across products and experiences.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise software, complex workflows, information-dense interfaces, and interaction patterns.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.1 AA, and experience incorporating accessibility considerations into visual design decisions
  • Comfort working in ambiguous environments, synthesizing inputs, forming design recommendations, and defending design rationale with stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with designers, product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Experience working on enterprise SaaS products.
  • Previous involvement in Design System initiatives or component library evolution.
  • Experience conducting competitive visual analysis and translating insights into design recommendations.
  • Familiarity with Material UI (MUI) or other enterprise design system frameworks.



Key Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with the Design System team to explore and define future visual directions for enterprise software products.
  • Explore, iterate, and refine visual design directions across areas such as color, typography, spacing, elevation, iconography, and overall product aesthetics.
  • Create high-fidelity design concepts and prototypes that demonstrate how visual design decisions apply across real product workflows and use cases.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable visual patterns that can be incorporated into the broader Design System.
  • Support design evaluation activities by preparing assets, prototypes, and presentation materials for stakeholder reviews and user feedback sessions.
  • Collaborate with product designers, researchers, engineers, and brand partners to align visual design direction with user needs and business goals.
  • Help translate brand principles into practical, scalable Design System solutions that can be adopted across products,
  • Advocate for accessibility, consistency, and usability throughout the design process.
  • Contribute to a culture of design excellence through collaboration, critique, and thoughtful design discussion.

title: Analista Pleno de Parcerias Institucionais
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista Pleno de Parcerias Institucionais em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Jusfy está em busca de uma pessoa Analista Pleno de Parcerias Institucionais. Somos uma legaltech em crescimento acelerado - desenvolvemos tecnologia, IA e ferramentas de produtividade para advogados e departamentos jurídicos do Brasil.

Nesta posição, você será responsável pela gestão operacional das parcerias estratégicas da Jusfy, atuando diretamente com entidades como a Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil, universidades e associações. Você vai garantir que essas parcerias aconteçam de ponta a ponta - da estruturação ao acompanhamento - assegurando execução, relacionamento e resultado.

Você terá uma atuação organizada e analítica, conduzindo o onboarding de novos parceiros, mantendo o relacionamento institucional no dia a dia e atuando como ponte entre Parcerias e as áreas internas para garantir que cada iniciativa saia do papel.

Esta é uma posição para pessoas com perfil mão na massa, forte senso de organização e facilidade de relacionamento com stakeholders institucionais, que gostam de estruturar processos e sustentar operações que crescem.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Apoiar operacionalmente a prospecção de novos parceiros institucionais, organizando pipeline, agendas, materiais e follow-ups de negociação.
  • Apoiar a formalização e documentação das parcerias, estruturando contrapartidas acordadas com cada parceiro.
  • Conduzir o onboarding operacional de parceiros, organizando kick-offs, cronogramas e planos de ação.
  • Mapear canais e oportunidades de divulgação e estruturar os fluxos de comunicação com parceiros.
  • Fazer o acompanhamento operacional das parcerias ativas, garantindo a execução das entregas acordadas.
  • Manter relacionamento recorrente com stakeholders institucionais e acompanhar indicadores e resultados.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e expansão das parcerias.
  • Atuar como ponte entre Parcerias, Marketing, Produto e Operações, garantindo alinhamento entre as áreas.
  • Apoiar a construção de materiais e apresentações institucionais.
  • Estruturar e manter controles, relatórios, indicadores e playbooks operacionais, garantindo previsibilidade à área.


O que buscamos:

  • Perfil organizado, executor e analítico, com forte senso de acompanhamento.
  • Boa comunicação institucional, verbal e escrita.
  • Capacidade de gerir múltiplas demandas simultaneamente.
  • Facilidade de relacionamento com stakeholders.
  • Experiência com organização de projetos e processos.
  • Excel ou Google Sheets intermediário.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com parcerias institucionais ou relações institucionais.
  • Experiência com entidades, associações ou universidades.
  • Experiência em startups, SaaS ou tecnologia - preferencialmente legaltech.
  • Familiaridade com CRM e ferramentas de gestão.
  • Experiência com eventos ou ações institucionais.


PJ | Remoto


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível no valor de R$ 265,00
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados)
  • Day Off de aniversário
  • Descanso remunerado
  • Ambiente descontraído e inovador
  • Oportunidade de atuar em projetos com impacto real no crescimento da empresa


Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Quer fazer parte de uma das legaltechs que mais cresce no Brasil? Se candidate na posição.

title: ML/AI Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para ML/AI Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ML/AI Engineer (Databricks)


Location: Remote (Brazil) | Type: Contract | Experience: 3 to 5+ years

About the Role


We're hiring an ML/AI Engineer to build and ship machine learning and AI systems on top of a modern Databricks data platform. You'll work close to the data, turning messy enterprise sources into features, models, and AI-powered applications that run reliably in production rather than living in a notebook.


The client is a data and AI platform company that modernizes how energy and heavy-industry enterprises work with their data, migrating legacy systems onto Databricks and the lakehouse and then building intelligence on top of it. The work is hands-on and full-lifecycle: you'll touch pipelines, models, and the services that put predictions in front of real users.


This role suits someone who likes living at the seam between data engineering and ML. If you've shipped models that depend on real pipelines holding up, and you want to do that work on a clean Databricks stack instead of fighting infrastructure, you'll feel at home here.


What You'll Do

  • Build, train, and validate ML models on Databricks, with real attention to evaluation, generalization, and where the model will actually be used
  • Engineer features and data transformations in Spark and SQL from enterprise sources that are rarely tidy
  • Stand up MLflow-based workflows for experiment tracking, model registry, and reproducible training runs
  • Deploy models as batch jobs or real-time endpoints, then keep them honest with monitoring for drift, latency, and cost
  • Partner with data engineers on the lakehouse layer so the data feeding your models is reliable and well-modeled
  • Bring LLM and retrieval techniques into the mix where they fit the problem, and skip them where they don't
  • Apply solid engineering habits throughout: version control, testing, code review, CI/CD


Qualifications

  • 3 to 5+ years building ML or AI systems in production, with strong Python fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks, including Spark and Delta Lake (Azure Databricks is a plus)
  • Comfort across the ML lifecycle: feature engineering, training, validation, deployment, and monitoring
  • Working knowledge of MLflow or a comparable experiment tracking and model registry tool
  • Strong SQL and a real understanding of how data pipelines feed models
  • Exposure to LLM-powered or retrieval-based applications, or genuine curiosity to grow into them
  • Professional working English, since collaboration happens across a distributed team


Why Join Us

You'll join a small, senior team that has been steadily building out a Databricks-based platform for demanding enterprise clients, where the data is complex and the standards for what ships are high. The work is remote and async-friendly, and your models won't sit on a shelf; they go into systems people actually depend on.


If you want ownership over real ML work on a clean, modern stack, with teammates who care about doing it right, this is a strong fit.


To apply, click Apply on LinkedIn and visit eliosai.com/browse-jobs

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Support Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Theta Data

Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.


We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.


The Role

We're hiring a Technical Support Engineer to be the front line of the customer experience at Theta Data. This is not a generic helpdesk role. Our customers are quantitative researchers, developers, and traders who ask technically sophisticated questions about financial data, APIs, and data integrity. You'll need to understand what they're asking and diagnose problems in depth.


Your primary responsibility is to monitor Intercom and Discord to identify, triage, and respond to customer issues as they come in. When you can resolve an issue or provide a working workaround, you do it. When you can't, write a clear, well-documented Jira ticket and escalate to Engineering with everything they need to act quickly, and track the ticket's progress until it's complete. We believe the most important feature is the one the customer already paid for. We take this promise seriously, and we want someone who will, too!


What You'll Do

  • Monitor Intercom and Discord and respond to incoming customer issues in a timely manner
  • Diagnose technical problems related to API behavior, data quality, authentication, request handling, and account set-up
  • Write and run Python scripts to reproduce issues and validate data against expected behavior
  • Make REST API calls to investigate and isolate bugs or unexpected responses
  • Provide workarounds and clear guidance to customers where possible
  • Write thorough, reproducible Jira tickets and escalate unresolved issues
  • Identify recurring issues and surface patterns to help prioritize fixes
  • Create and maintain internal documentation on common issues, workarounds, and resolution steps


What We're Looking For

Required

  • Experience working in a technical support or customer-facing engineering role
  • Comfort working with REST APIs, including reading documentation, making requests, and interpreting responses
  • Working knowledge of Python for scripting, data inspection, and reproducing issues
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both customers and engineers
  • Detail-oriented and systematic approach to diagnosing problems
  • Weekend support rotation


Nice to Have

  • Prior experience with financial data APIs
  • Familiarity with financial data concepts (options, equities, market data, OHLCV, Greeks, etc.)
  • Familiarity with Jira or similar issue tracking tools
  • Experience with Intercom or similar support platforms
  • Exposure to SQL or database queries for data validation


Why Theta Data

  • Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast
  • Real challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data
  • High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter; you will influence how we operate
  • Remote-first: work from anywhere
  • Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily
  • A role that rewards genuine curiosity about financial data and technical problem-solving

title: Chef Corporativo Parceiro
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Chef Corporativo Parceiro em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Unox , líder global na produção de fornos de alta qualidade e orgulhosamente certificada como Great Place to Work® no Brasil, está procurando Chefs Corporativos para se juntar à nossa equipe de parceiros nacionais.


Nessa função, você será responsável por demonstrar, treinar e orientar clientes e parceiros sobre o uso eficiente das tecnologias da Unox , promovendo soluções inovadoras que otimizem processos e elevem a qualidade e rentabilidade das operações culinárias.


Atividades:

  • Conduzir treinamentos práticos e técnicos para equipes de cozinha;
  • Desenvolver receitas que demonstrem a versatilidade dos equipamentos;
  • Realizar demonstrações para clientes, eventos e feiras do setor;
  • Apoiar a equipe comercial com insights técnicos e argumentos estratégicos;
  • Acompanhar tendências gastronômicas e propor soluções inovadoras;
  • Oferecer suporte pós-venda para garantir performance máxima dos produtos UNOX.


Requisitos:

  • Formação técnica ou experiência prévia em Gastronomia e áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em fornos combinados e diferentes técnicas de cocção;
  • CNH (B) ativa e disponibilidade para viagens e deslocamentos;
  • Boa comunicação interpessoal e habilidades de apresentação;
  • Proatividade e perfil mão na massa;
  • Desejável: Inglês Intermediário.


Informações Adicionais:

  • Atuação como embaixador da marca;
  • Atuação PRESENCIAL sob demanda;
  • Fornecemos treinamento presencial e remoto sobre nossa tecnologia e equipamentos;
  • Contratação PJ.



Por que Unox?

Inovação contínua : A Unox está na vanguarda da tecnologia e inovação, trabalhando em projetos pioneiros e desafiadores.


Ambiente de trabalho : Fomos certificados pelo Great Place To Work Institute como uma das 100 melhores empresas da Europa. Nosso ambiente de trabalho jovem e positivo promove a colaboração e valoriza as ideias de todos os nossos funcionários. Organizamos regularmente eventos da empresa para networking e formação de equipes com colegas.


Crescimento Profissional : A Unox investe no desenvolvimento de seus colaboradores por meio de programas de treinamento contínuo, coaching individual e oportunidades de carreira, garantindo constante crescimento pessoal e profissional.


O posto de trabalho está aberto a candidatos de todos os gêneros e identidades de gênero, em conformidade com os regulamentos atuais de igualdade de oportunidades.
