title: Data Architect (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Architect (Relocation to Portugal) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Minimum 6 years of experience as a Data Engineer;
  • Strong experience in Data Architecture;
  • Hands-on experience with Cloud platforms: Azure, AWS, and/or GCP;
  • Experience with Big Data tools and technologies, including Databricks;
  • Solid experience with ETL processes and data integration via APIs;
  • Experience across the full lifecycle: implementation, development, and maintenance;
  • English level B2 or higher;
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid, based in Portugal.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!


The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

title: FP&A - Conciliação Bancária Automatizada
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para FP&A - Conciliação Bancária Automatizada em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Pia3Ai · 100% Remoto · PJ · B2B / SaaS No Code


Esta vaga é para quem pensa em dados e processos, não para perfis de finanças tradicionais ou desenvolvimento de software. Se você gosta de configurar sistemas, entender lógica de negócio, possui conhecimento profundo em conciliação bancária e entregar soluções que funcionam — leia com atenção.


FUNÇÕES:


  • Implementar nossa plataforma No Code de conciliação bancária e operacional nos clientes B2B;
  • Mapear e configurar as regras de negócio do cliente dentro do sistema (lógica de chaves, bases relacionais, fluxos de conciliação);
  • Ingerir, organizar e validar dados financeiros dos clientes na plataforma;
  • Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento e acompanhamento com os clientes durante a implementação;

title: Senior AI Architect, GenAI & Document Intelligence
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior AI Architect, GenAI & Document Intelligence em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Alyra Technology builds AI-enabled software and automation systems for document-heavy, regulated industries: insurance, legal, finance and healthcare. We pair modern Microsoft Azure architecture with applied generative AI to ship systems that are explainable, auditable and production-ready, not demos. Our work centers on pulling structure, meaning and decisions out of complex, unstructured documents at scale.

Role Description

We're hiring a senior Azure architect who's designed production GenAI systems for messy, real-world documents, and done it for years. Contracts, filings, policies, medical records, financial statements. If you've bolted GPT onto a web app, this isn't your role. If you've built production GenAI pipelines for document-heavy, regulated work, keep reading.

This role is architecture-first. You'll turn ambiguous AI ideas into clear, defensible system designs covering data flows, agent interactions, retrieval pipelines, security boundaries and auditability, primarily on Microsoft Azure. We pull you in as projects launch, so the cadence flexes with the work, lighter in steady stretches and heavier during active builds.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years designing and shipping production AI systems, not just prototyping them
  • 5+ years working directly with unstructured text and document-centric AI. This is non-negotiable.
  • Proven production RAG, multi-agent or document intelligence pipelines at real-world complexity
  • Deep, hands-on Azure platform experience, end to end
  • A real understanding of how GenAI fails in production: hallucination, retrieval quality, context limits, latency and cost at scale
  • Ability to design for auditability and explainability in compliance-sensitive environments
  • 7+ years total software or platform engineering experience
  • Located in Brazil, with professional English, written and spoken

Preferred Qualifications  

  • Hands-on with complex multi-page documents: contracts, legal filings, medical records, financial statements, insurance forms or regulatory submissions 
  • Layout-aware parsing tools such as Azure Document Intelligence, Unstructured or LayoutLM
  • Document-grounded output systems where every answer traces back to a specific source passage or page 
  • Client-facing architecture experience in insurance, legal, finance or healthcare 
  • Comfort working alongside AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code

How To Apply

Submit your resume in English.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Support Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Theta Data

Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.


We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.


The Role

We're hiring a Technical Support Engineer to be the front line of the customer experience at Theta Data. This is not a generic helpdesk role. Our customers are quantitative researchers, developers, and traders who ask technically sophisticated questions about financial data, APIs, and data integrity. You'll need to understand what they're asking and diagnose problems in depth.


Your primary responsibility is to monitor Intercom and Discord to identify, triage, and respond to customer issues as they come in. When you can resolve an issue or provide a working workaround, you do it. When you can't, write a clear, well-documented Jira ticket and escalate to Engineering with everything they need to act quickly, and track the ticket's progress until it's complete. We believe the most important feature is the one the customer already paid for. We take this promise seriously, and we want someone who will, too!


What You'll Do

  • Monitor Intercom and Discord and respond to incoming customer issues in a timely manner
  • Diagnose technical problems related to API behavior, data quality, authentication, request handling, and account set-up
  • Write and run Python scripts to reproduce issues and validate data against expected behavior
  • Make REST API calls to investigate and isolate bugs or unexpected responses
  • Provide workarounds and clear guidance to customers where possible
  • Write thorough, reproducible Jira tickets and escalate unresolved issues
  • Identify recurring issues and surface patterns to help prioritize fixes
  • Create and maintain internal documentation on common issues, workarounds, and resolution steps


What We're Looking For

Required

  • Experience working in a technical support or customer-facing engineering role
  • Comfort working with REST APIs, including reading documentation, making requests, and interpreting responses
  • Working knowledge of Python for scripting, data inspection, and reproducing issues
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both customers and engineers
  • Detail-oriented and systematic approach to diagnosing problems
  • Weekend support rotation


Nice to Have

  • Prior experience with financial data APIs
  • Familiarity with financial data concepts (options, equities, market data, OHLCV, Greeks, etc.)
  • Familiarity with Jira or similar issue tracking tools
  • Experience with Intercom or similar support platforms
  • Exposure to SQL or database queries for data validation


Why Theta Data

  • Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast
  • Real challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data
  • High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter; you will influence how we operate
  • Remote-first: work from anywhere
  • Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily
  • A role that rewards genuine curiosity about financial data and technical problem-solving

title: Digital Marketing Director
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Digital Marketing Director em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

SPOKEN ENGLISH IS A MUST!

*Please make sure to submit your resume in English; it will not be accepted otherwise. The interview process will also be conducted in English.


Digital Marketing Director

Location: Remote


About Us:

Smart Age Solutions is a leading digital marketing and technology agency specializing in the jewelry industry. We help some of the most recognized jewelry retailers and luxury brands grow through cutting-edge digital strategies, including SEO, Paid Media, Social Media, Email Marketing, Web Development, Conversion Optimization, AI-driven marketing solutions, and eCommerce.


With team members across the United States and Latin America, we combine deep industry expertise with innovation, data, and technology to deliver measurable growth for our clients.


As we continue to scale, we are seeking an experienced Marketing Director to lead our marketing organization, oversee department leadership, and help shape the future of our agency.



Role Overview

The Digital Marketing Director will serve as a senior leader within the company, responsible for overseeing the performance, strategy, and development of multiple marketing departments.

This role is not responsible for executing campaigns directly. Instead, the Marketing Director will lead and develop department managers across SEO, Paid Media, Social Media, Design, Copywriting, Content, and Marketing Operations while ensuring alignment, accountability, operational efficiency, and client success.


The ideal candidate is a proven marketing leader with agency experience, strong business acumen, exceptional people management skills, and a deep understanding of modern digital marketing strategies, analytics, automation, AI, and performance marketing.

This individual will play a critical role in scaling Smart Age Solutions while maintaining the quality, innovation, and results that define our brand.



Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute the company's overall marketing vision and departmental strategy.
  • Align marketing initiatives with company growth objectives, revenue goals, retention targets, and client success metrics.
  • Establish department-wide KPIs, accountability systems, and performance standards.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and profitability.


Department Leadership

  • Manage and mentor department managers across:
  • SEO
  • Paid Media (Google Ads, Meta Ads, Programmatic)
  • Social Media
  • Design & Creative
  • Copywriting & Content
  • Marketing Operations
  • Create clear growth paths, coaching programs, and professional development plans for leaders and team members.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.


Performance & Analytics

  • Establish and monitor KPIs across all service lines.
  • Analyze performance trends and identify opportunities for optimization.
  • Drive data-informed decision-making throughout the organization.
  • Ensure departments are delivering measurable results for clients.
  • Oversee reporting frameworks, dashboards, forecasting, and performance reviews.


Client Strategy & Growth

  • Partner with Account Management and Executive Leadership to support high-level client strategy.
  • Participate in key client meetings and executive reviews when strategic leadership is required.
  • Help identify opportunities for account growth, retention, and improved client outcomes.
  • Ensure marketing strategies align with client business goals and industry best practices.


Innovation & Technology

  • Champion the adoption of AI, automation, and emerging marketing technologies.
  • Evaluate new platforms, tools, and technologies that improve efficiency and results.
  • Drive innovation initiatives across departments.
  • Help position our company as a leader in digital marketing within the jewelry industry.


Operational Excellence

  • Improve workflows, processes, SOPs, and cross-department collaboration.
  • Ensure departments are properly staffed, resourced, and structured for growth.
  • Work closely with executive leadership to forecast hiring needs and organizational development.
  • Assist in building scalable systems that support the company's long-term growth strategy.


Financial Management

  • Monitor departmental performance against revenue and profitability goals.
  • Assist with resource allocation, budgeting, forecasting, and capacity planning.
  • Ensure efficient utilization of team resources while maintaining service quality.



Qualifications

Required

  • Fluent English, written and verbal communication skills.
  • 8+ years of digital marketing experience.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing managers and multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Proven success leading teams across SEO, Paid Media, Social Media, Content, and Creative.
  • Strong understanding of performance marketing, analytics, attribution, conversion optimization, and customer acquisition strategies.
  • Experience working within a digital marketing agency environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to build, scale, and optimize high-performing teams.
  • Strong business, operational, and financial acumen.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and leadership skills.
  • Experience managing KPIs, forecasting, reporting, and strategic planning.


Preferred

  • Experience in eCommerce, luxury, retail, or jewelry industries.
  • Experience implementing AI and automation solutions within marketing operations.
  • Experience with platforms such as:
  • Google Analytics 4
  • Google Ads
  • Meta Ads Manager
  • HubSpot
  • Shopify
  • Looker Studio
  • SEMrush
  • Whatagraph
  • Asana, ClickUp, Monday, Jira, or similar project management platforms
  • MBA or Master's Degree in Marketing, Business, or related field.



What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means:

  • Building high-performing department leaders.
  • Improving efficiency and collaboration across teams.
  • Driving measurable improvements in client performance and retention.
  • Scaling processes, systems, and team structures.
  • Introducing innovation and AI-driven solutions.
  • Helping the company continue its growth as a leading digital marketing agency.



Why Join Our Team?

  • Work with some of the most recognized jewelry retailers and luxury brands in North America.
  • Lead a talented and growing team of digital marketing professionals.
  • Opportunity to shape the future direction of a rapidly growing agency.
  • Collaborative, entrepreneurial, and innovation-driven culture.
  • Remote-first work environment with global collaboration.


We believe exceptional talent comes from diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all qualified candidates are welcomed and encouraged to apply.

We're excited to learn about your experience, leadership style, and vision for building world-class marketing teams.


*Candidates are expected to dress professionally throughout all stages of the interview process.

title: Especialista em CRM e Automação de Jornadas WhatsApp
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista em CRM e Automação de Jornadas WhatsApp em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Modelo de contratação

  • Contratação PJ
  • Home Office


Importante: Esta vaga é destinada a profissionais que já tenham atuado diretamente na construção, implementação e otimização de jornadas de CRM via WhatsApp em larga escala. Experiências limitadas a disparos pontuais, operação básica de CRM ou execução de campanhas sem atuação estratégica não atendem ao perfil da posição.


A ConCrédito é uma das empresas que mais crescem no mercado de crédito consignado e soluções financeiras digitais no Brasil. Atuamos com crédito consignado para CLT, INSS, SIAPE e antecipação do FGTS, oferecendo uma experiência simples, segura e totalmente digital aos nossos clientes. Estamos entre as 3 melhores empresas do segmento no Reclame Aqui e entre as 35 empresas de maior crescimento do país, segundo a Revista Exame. Vivemos um momento estratégico de expansão e evolução tecnológica, com forte investimento em dados, automação, inteligência operacional e experiência do cliente.


Sobre a oportunidade:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista em CRM com experiência comprovada em jornadas de relacionamento via WhatsApp em larga escala para liderar a evolução da nossa operação de CRM. Essa pessoa terá papel fundamental na construção da estratégia de relacionamento da empresa, conectando dados, automações, segmentações e comunicação para aumentar conversão, retenção, engajamento e eficiência operacional. Mais do que operar campanhas, buscamos alguém capaz de estruturar processos, definir boas práticas, construir governança e criar uma operação escalável de CRM orientada por dados.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência comprovada com CRM e jornadas de relacionamento via WhatsApp em larga escala.
  • Experiência com segmentação, automação, testes, monitoramento e otimização de campanhas.
  • Vivência na implementação ou estruturação de ferramentas de CRM, Marketing Automation ou Customer Engagement.
  • Conhecimento sólido em SQL e análise de dados.
  • Experiência com integrações, APIs, webhooks e automações.
  • Conhecimento das boas práticas da WhatsApp Business Platform / Cloud API.
  • Experiência em desenho de jornadas orientadas ao ciclo de vida do cliente.
  • Conhecimento de métricas de CRM, experimentação e mensuração de resultados.
  • Capacidade de atuar com áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Conhecimento sobre LGPD, consentimento e governança de dados.


Responsabilidades:

  • Estruturar e implementar boas práticas de CRM durante a evolução da plataforma.
  • Desenhar, implementar e otimizar jornadas de relacionamento via WhatsApp em larga escala.
  • Criar estratégias de aquisição, ativação, nutrição, conversão, retenção, reengajamento e pós-venda.
  • Transformar objetivos de negócio em segmentações, gatilhos, regras de elegibilidade, réguas de comunicação e indicadores.
  • Definir e organizar a estrutura de dados necessária para suportar as jornadas.
  • Construir segmentações e audiências utilizando dados do Snowflake.
  • Integrar dados, automações e canais por meio do N8N, WhatsApp Cloud API e ColmeIA.cx.
  • Definir padrões para templates, personalização, frequência de comunicação, testes A/B e governança dos disparos.
  • Garantir boas práticas de entregabilidade e escalabilidade no WhatsApp.
  • Desenvolver dashboards, funis e rotinas de acompanhamento de performance.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com as áreas de Dados, Tecnologia, Growth, Comercial e Operações.
  • Documentar processos, aprendizados, playbooks e padrões operacionais.


Indicadores sob sua responsabilidade:

  • Taxas de entrega, leitura, clique, resposta e conversão.
  • Taxa de reativação de clientes.
  • Taxa de opt-out, bloqueios e denúncias.
  • Qualidade da conta e saúde do canal WhatsApp.
  • Conversão por jornada, público, produto e etapa do funil.
  • Receita gerada pelas ações de CRM.
  • ROI das campanhas.
  • Eficiência operacional das automações.
  • Qualidade e confiabilidade dos dados utilizados.
  • Resultados de testes A/B e iniciativas de otimização.


O que esperamos que você seja capaz de entregar nos primeiros 90 dias:

  • Diagnóstico completo da operação atual de CRM.
  • Mapeamento das principais jornadas de WhatsApp.
  • Estruturação das boas práticas de governança e comunicação.
  • Definição do modelo de segmentação e gestão de dados.
  • Implementação de dashboards e rotinas de acompanhamento.
  • Criação de backlog de melhorias, hipóteses e automações prioritárias.


Desafio :

Você será responsável por desenhar e evoluir jornadas completas de relacionamento utilizando o WhatsApp como principal canal de comunicação, atuando desde a definição da estratégia até a implementação, análise de resultados e otimização contínua. Também participará diretamente da implementação e amadurecimento da nossa estrutura de CRM, ajudando a transformar dados e oportunidades de negócio em jornadas automatizadas e mensuráveis.


Stack Atual

Você atuará em um ambiente moderno, com foco em dados e automação:

  • Snowflake para Data Warehouse e segmentações
  • Metabase para análises e acompanhamento de indicadores
  • N8N para integrações e automações
  • WhatsApp Cloud API para comunicação oficial
  • ColmeIA.cx para automação multicanal e gestão de jornadas


Perfil que buscamos:

  • Perfil hands-on e orientado à execução.
  • Forte capacidade analítica.
  • Organização e visão de processos.
  • Senso de dono e autonomia.
  • Capacidade de construir estruturas do zero.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar com diferentes áreas.
  • Visão crítica para identificar gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Mentalidade orientada a dados e resultados. 


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Snowflake, Metabase, N8N, WhatsApp Cloud API ou ColmeIA.cx.
  • Experiência em fintechs, crédito consignado, antecipação de FGTS ou serviços financeiros.
  • Conhecimento em CDP, CRM Lifecycle, Customer Data Platform e automação conversacional.
  • Experiência com IA aplicada à comunicação e atendimento.
  • Experiência em governança de templates e escalabilidade de canais WhatsApp.
  • Vivência com Growth, Dados, Produto, CX, Vendas ou Operações.
  • Certificações em CRM, Analytics, SQL, Marketing Automation ou plataformas de automação.


O que você vai encontrar na concrédito:

  • Autonomia para construir e evoluir uma operação de CRM estratégica.
  • Ambiente altamente orientado a dados.
  • Contato direto com tecnologia, dados, growth e operação.
  • Espaço para gerar impacto real no negócio.
  • Participação ativa em um momento importante de crescimento e transformação da empresa.
  • Time com foco em inovação, velocidade e execução.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Systems Administrator (with AWS) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About this role

Boldin is hiring a Senior Systems Administrator to own the reliability, security, and performance of the compute, identity, endpoint, and SaaS services our team depends on every day. You will design and operate resilient infrastructure, drive automation, lead complex incidents, and own lifecycle work across a hybrid environment. You will work as a peer to our existing engineer, who will focus on cloud and security engineering.


What you will own

  • Infrastructure and cloud operations. Keep core systems healthy and performant across our cloud and SaaS environment. Run patching, capacity planning, and lifecycle work end to end.
  • Identity and access. Operate SSO, directory, and access lifecycle. Run joiner, mover, and leaver flows. Keep entitlements clean and reviewed.
  • Endpoint and device management. Own the device fleet through MDM.
  • Patching, configuration baselines, compliance posture, and support.
  • Monitoring, incident response, and automation. Tune alerts, run runbooks, lead incidents to root cause, and ship the automation that prevents the next one.
  • Security operations and compliance support. Operate the controls that live in IT: access reviews, endpoint posture, training, and audit evidence.
  • Documentation and continuous improvement. Maintain runbooks, mentor as the team grows, and raise the bar over time.


What you bring

  • Five or more years in a senior systems administration or IT engineering role. You have run an environment, not just executed tickets.
  • Strong cloud experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and modern OS administration (Linux or macOS at scale; Windows server welcome).

title: Remote Business Analyst (German)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Quality Assurance Automação
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Quality Assurance Automação em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade imediata para profissional especialista em Qualidade de Softwares com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.


O QA de Automação é o profissional responsável por estruturar, implementar e sustentar a automação de testes ao longo do ciclo de desenvolvimento, assegurando qualidade, rastreabilidade e velocidade nas entregas. Sua atuação vai além da execução técnica: ele contribui para a prevenção de defeitos, fortalecimento da cultura de qualidade e aumento da confiança do time nas releases. Esse papel é especialmente relevante em ambientes com entregas contínuas, múltiplas integrações e necessidade de regressão frequente, pois reduz esforço manual, aumenta a previsibilidade e melhora a estabilidade do produto.


Escopo de atuação

O profissional atua na definição da estratégia de testes automatizados, desenho de cenários críticos, implementação de frameworks, integração com pipelines, análise de falhas, manutenção da suíte de regressão e apoio à evolução das práticas de qualidade do time.



Responsabilidades

  • Implementar, manter e evoluir testes automatizados para aplicações web, APIs e, quando aplicável, fluxos integrados entre sistemas.
  • Participar da análise de requisitos, refinamentos e critérios de aceite, contribuindo com visão preventiva de qualidade desde as etapas iniciais do desenvolvimento.
  • Definir a melhor abordagem de automação para cada contexto, equilibrando cobertura, custo de manutenção, estabilidade e retorno sobre investimento.
  • Integrar a execução dos testes automatizados às pipelines de CI/CD, garantindo feedback rápido e confiável para o time.
  • Estruturar e manter massa de testes, dados de apoio, mocks, stubs e evidências necessárias para execução consistente dos cenários automatizados.
  • Monitorar falhas recorrentes, identificar causas-raiz e atuar em conjunto com desenvolvedores e demais QAs na melhoria contínua da qualidade.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de qualidade, cobertura, tempo de execução, taxa de falhas e efetividade da automação.
  • Apoiar a definição e evolução de padrões, boas práticas, convenções de código e arquitetura dos frameworks de teste.
  • Contribuir com a estratégia de Shift Left, promovendo testes antecipados, prevenção de defeitos e maior colaboração entre QA, desenvolvimento e produto.
  • Documentar cenários, fluxos automatizados, premissas técnicas e limitações da suíte de testes para facilitar reuso e manutenção.



Competências técnicas esperadas

  • Experiência com automação de testes para API e Web.
  • Conhecimento em C# e/ou Python, com boa base de lógica, estruturação de código e manutenção de automações.
  • Vivência com ferramentas e frameworks como Selenium, Robot Framework, ReqNRoll ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com testes orientados a comportamento, quando aplicável, utilizando BDD para estruturar cenários de negócio.
  • Conhecimento de integração contínua e pipelines de CI/CD para execução automatizada de testes.
  • Experiência com versionamento de código, preferencialmente com Git.
  • Capacidade de elaborar cenários de teste rastreáveis a requisitos e critérios de aceite.
  • Conhecimento de testes funcionais, regressivos, smoke tests e validação de serviços.
  • Conhecimento de consultas a banco de dados para validação de dados e apoio à investigação de defeitos.
  • Leitura e interpretação de logs, evidências e relatórios de execução.



Conhecimentos desejáveis

  • Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade e dashboards, como Grafana.
  • Experiência com testes de contrato, mocks e virtualização de serviços.
  • Conhecimento de estratégias de qualidade em arquitetura distribuída, microsserviços e integrações.
  • Familiaridade com testes de performance, segurança ou resiliência, mesmo que não seja o foco principal da posição.
  • Vivência com containers, ambientes em nuvem ou orquestração de execução de testes.
  • Conhecimento de métricas de qualidade e governança de testes.


Capacidades esperadas

  • Capacidade de construir suítes de testes automatizados reutilizáveis, legíveis e de fácil manutenção.
  • Capacidade de selecionar cenários com maior retorno para automação, evitando baixa eficiência ou excesso de manutenção.
  • Capacidade de estruturar testes com rastreabilidade entre requisito, cenário, evidência e resultado.
  • Capacidade de integrar testes ao fluxo de entrega contínua, com execução confiável e feedback rápido.
  • Capacidade de diagnosticar falhas de automação, diferenciar falso positivo de defeito real e atuar na estabilização da suíte.
  • Capacidade de colaborar com o time para elevar a maturidade de qualidade e prevenir defeitos desde o início do ciclo.


Requisitos de formação e experiência

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com qualidade de software, testes automatizados e atuação em times ágeis.
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis, especialmente Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Experiência em interação com times multidisciplinares, incluindo desenvolvimento, produto e QA manual.


Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Ter certificações em testes, qualidade ou automação.
  • Ter experiência em ambientes regulados, sistemas críticos ou produtos com alta necessidade de rastreabilidade.
  • Ter vivência com testes em arquitetura de microsserviços, mensageria, filas ou integrações complexas.
  • Ter atuado na criação de frameworks do zero ou na modernização de esteiras de qualidade.
  • Experiência em projetos de Inteligência Artificial.

title: Account Representative

About the Role


As an Account Representative, you will be responsible for expanding SHEMAR's presence in your assigned market by developing strategic customer relationships and turning technical advantages into commercial success. You will work closely with industry-leading utilities, EPCs, and industrial customers, helping them solve critical challenges while driving sustainable business growth.



Responsibilities


Market Development & Business Growth

• Develop and execute market expansion strategies based on the company's Key Account Map and regional business objectives.

• Identify new business opportunities and convert SHEMAR's technical advantages and product solutions into commercial orders.

• Continuously monitor market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities to drive market penetration.


Customer Relationship Management

• Build and maintain strong relationships with customers at multiple organizational levels, including technical teams, procurement departments, and senior executives. • Understand customers' strategic priorities and business challenges, positioning SHEMAR as a trusted long-term partner. • Support high-level business discussions and facilitate strategic decision-making processes.


Project & Opportunity Management

• Lead the full sales cycle for strategic projects, including UHV transmission, offshore wind power, and other critical power infrastructure applications. • Independently manage complex projects and contracts ranging from hundreds of thousands to millions of dollars. • Coordinate bidding, commercial negotiations, and project execution to ensure successful order closure and delivery.


Cross-functional Collaboration

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• Fluent in English and Portuguese, both written and spoken.

Preferred

• Ambitious and entrepreneurial, with a strong desire to create long-term impact.

• Resilient and adaptable in fast-changing market environments.

• Customer-oriented and eager to build trusted partnerships.

• Innovative thinkers who are willing to challenge conventions and explore new possibilities.



What We Offer


Competitive Compensation

• Competitive base salary positioned above industry benchmarks.

• Performance-based annual bonus.

• Attractive project commissions with uncapped earning potential.

• Additional incentives for exceptional business achievements.


Career Development

Clear career progression pathways: Sales Expert Track; Team Management Track; Cross-functional opportunities in Product Management and Marketing


Comprehensive Support

• Strong technical backing from experienced engineers and industry experts.

• Opportunities to work on landmark projects in UHV, renewable energy, and global power infrastructure.

• International exposure and a platform for long-term professional growth.

We are committed to diversity and inclusivity.

title: Content Writer & Editor
description:

⚠️ Please note : We will NOT review applications that are made through LinkedIn. Please ensure you have read the entire job posting and how to apply. Anyone who does not follow the \"How to Apply\" section, will not be considered. ⚠️


Location: Remote


About SearchTides

SearchTides is a digital marketing agency that specializes in search engine optimization (SEO) and Link Building. We provide services related to SEO including but not limited to the delivery of \"Backlinks\" to its clients.


Role Overview

SearchTides is seeking a talented and versatile Content Writer & Editor who excels at creating and refining engaging, AI-assisted articles that naturally incorporate client backlinks.

In this hybrid role, you will both write original content and edit articles created by other team members, ensuring all content meets our high-quality standards while seamlessly integrating backlinks. This is a comprehensive writing and editing position.


The ideal candidate is a collaborative and adaptable professional who thrives in a fast-paced team environment, can work efficiently under time constraints, and has a sharp eye for both creative writing and meticulous editing. You should be comfortable tailoring tone and style to suit a variety of industries and audiences.


As part of our Content Team, you will work within our streamlined workflow system to produce and polish high-quality articles for backlink purposes. You will receive briefs including target URL, anchor text, and publishing website details, and will be responsible for the full content lifecycle, from topic ideation through final quality checks.


We regularly work with a range of industries, including:

  • US Sports
  • Casino & Gambling
  • Finance


Responsibilities

  • Propose engaging, relevant topic ideas
  • Create well-researched, original, and high-quality AI-assisted articles words)
  • Build natural context around anchor text to seamlessly integrate backlinks
  • Work efficiently to complete articles within time constraints
  • Submit content to our Editorial team and complete any revisions if needed
  • Edit and polish articles created by other writers
  • Proofread for grammar, clarity, tone, and flow; ensure correct link placement and quality standards are met


Requirements & Qualifications

  • Proven experience writing for backlink building, or guest posting (+1 years)
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication (native-level)
  • Ability to follow briefs and content guidelines precisely
  • Familiar with AI writing tools and ability to work with AI-generated content
  • Comfortable working independently
  • Professional attitude toward communication, deadlines, revisions and feedback
  • Strong editorial skills with attention to detail (comfortable wearing both hats)
  • Detail-oriented and thorough
  • Proficiency with Google Suite, Gmail, Slack
  • Must have access to a computer and reliable internet
  • Knowledge of link building is preferred
  • Ability to switch between writing and editing tasks quickly and efficiently
  • Strong time management skills; ability to work efficiently within tight timeframes


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in blog writing and editing
  • Experience with databases such as SeaTable or AirTable


Why Join SearchTides

  • Full remote flexibility – work from anywhere
  • Working remotely, but being part of a team
  • Influence high-profile client campaigns
  • Streamlined workflow with clear processes and expectations


How to Apply

Please send your resume/CV AND cover letter to

Sobre a oportunidade


Estamos em busca de um(a) Head Comercial para liderar a expansão da nossa frente de Dados, atuando na geração de novos negócios, desenvolvimento de mercado e crescimento de receita. • Desenvolver e executar estratégias comerciais para expansão da vertical de Dados da UDS;

• Prospectar e conquistar novos clientes, ampliando a receita e a presença da empresa no mercado;

• Identificar oportunidades de projetos e soluções em Dados, Analytics, BI, Engenharia de Dados e Inteligência Artificial;

• Conduzir negociações consultivas de médio e grande porte junto a executivos e tomadores de decisão;

• Construir relacionamento com C-Levels, Diretores, Heads e gestores das áreas de Tecnologia, Dados, Inovação, Operações e Negócios;

• Gerenciar todo o ciclo comercial, desde a prospecção até o fechamento dos contratos;

• Atuar em parceria com os times técnicos e de pré-vendas na construção de propostas de valor aderentes às necessidades dos clientes;

• Monitorar indicadores, pipeline, forecast e metas comerciais;

• Contribuir para o posicionamento da UDS como referência em soluções de Dados e IA no mercado.


Requisitos


• Experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas B2B com foco em Dados, Analytics, Business Intelligence, Engenharia de Dados ou Inteligência Artificial;

• Perfil Hunter, com forte capacidade de geração de demanda e abertura de mercado;

• Histórico consistente de fechamento de contratos de serviços e projetos de tecnologia;

• Experiência na negociação com empresas de médio e grande porte;

• Conhecimento do mercado de Dados e suas principais tendências, desafios e oportunidades;

• Vivência em consultorias de Dados ou consultorias de Tecnologia que possuam áreas relevantes de Dados e Analytics;

• Forte orientação para resultados, metas, indicadores e crescimento de receita;

• Excelente comunicação, negociação e relacionamento executivo.


Desejáveis


• Experiência comercializando soluções de IA Generativa;

• Vivência em empresas de consultoria de dados, analytics ou transformação digital;

• Carteira de relacionamento com executivos das áreas de Tecnologia, Dados, Inovação e Transformação Digital;

• Conhecimento em plataformas cloud (AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud) aplicadas a projetos de Dados;

• Experiência na estruturação ou expansão de unidades de negócio focadas em Dados.
